'''Stage III Dispatchers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

Killing one will grant the {{AdvancementLink|HE Suppression}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned after a [[Stage II Dispatcher]] evolves.
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage IV Dispatcher]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage III Dispatchers are Stationary Offensive Support Parasites.
*Stage III Dispatchers can store and teleport parasites around using [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]], Stage III Dispatchers can summon up to 9. Parasites that have been stored by a Dispatcher that despawn will end up back in the Dispatcher's storage.
**[[Buglin|Buglins]] stored by Stage III Dispatchers will become [[Rupter|Rupters]].
**[[Rupter|Rupters]] stored by Stage III Dispatchers will become [[Mangler|Manglers]].
**4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored by Stage III Dispatchers will become a [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]].
**[[Incomplete Forms]] stored by a Stage III Dispatcher reaching 6 value (with [[Small Incomplete Form|Small]] having a value of 1 and [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium]] having a value of 2) will create a [[Crux]].
*Stage III Dispatchers can summon up to 7 [[Seizer|Seizers]] and [[Sentry|Sentries]] to defend them.
*Stage III Dispatchers will force nearby [[Assimilated Mobs]] to drop their disguise (unless if they are on water).
*Stage III Dispatchers throw 6 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. These bombs inflict 14 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage III Dispatchers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 7, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 4 Blocks range.
*Stage III Dispatchers will apply the following effects to parasites:
**Speed II (5:00)
**Regeneration III (5:00)
**Strength III (5:00)
**[[Debar]] I (5:00)
**[[Link]] II (6:40)
**[[Heightened Senses]] III (5:00)
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, Stage III Dispatchers will become [[Stage II Dispatcher|Stage II Dispatchers]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage III Dispatchers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
**Any entities a Dispatcher summons will also be on fire. (Note that fire is not enough to outright kill their tentacles)

* Right clicking on any of their Dispatcher Tentacles or Seizers will apply the glowing effect to their Dispatcher.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Stage III Dispatchers do not despawn.
* Stage III Dispatchers are also known as '''DodSIII''' in the Mod Files.
* In the early builds of [[Version 1.9.6|1.9.6]], Dispatchers used to be called ‘’’Reinforcers’’’.
